label: Full PCam retrain (CPU)
message: Trained on all 262,144 official train patches (8 epochs, CPU bf16; epoch 3 selected by val AUC 0.9587). Evaluated on the full 32,768 official test set. Platt calibration and threshold chosen on validation. Educational research only — not for clinical use.

compared_to_baseline.note: Baseline used a fixed-seed 8,000-patch test subset; full retrain uses the full 32,768 official test split — not a paired comparison on identical samples.
